description: Defines classes and functions for GTP-U GTP protocol gateway sessions, including session management, creation, and network resource handling within the ocudu namespace.

classes.name: gtpu_tnl_pdu_session
classes.description: Abstract class handling GTP-U TNL PDU transmission and reception, providing methods to get bind address and port.

classes.name: gtpu_gateway
classes.description: Abstract class for creating new GTP-U TNL PDU sessions.

methods.name: get_bind_address
methods.description: Retrieves the IP address the session is bound to.

methods.name: get_bind_port
methods.description: Retrieves the port used for receiving PDUs, if applicable.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Creates a new GTP-U TNL PDU session.
